text: This Pournami that comes in the month of Bhadrapada has a special place in our tradition.
One fortnight ends with the full moon.
Immediately after that begins Krishna Paksha.
Mahālaya Paksha, when we remember our ancestors.
That is why Bhadrapada Pournami stands as a symbol of a beautiful change.
towards remembering the ancestors who gave us this life.
Remembering our ancestors is not just about performing a ritual.
There was a generation before us.
We exist today in that very lineage.
That is why Sanatanam gave as much importance to gratitude as it did to the divine.
Remembering our roots is honoring our existence.
